analyses.title: Acme Corp Q3 Liquidity Review (Renamed Audit)
analyses.inputText: During the third quarter, operating revenue contracted by 14% year-over-year to $42.5 million. Furthermore, gross margin dropped from 58% to 41% due to severe cost inflation and material shortages across our primary supply chain. Operating cash flow deficit reached $18.2 million, resulting in declining cash reserves of only $6.4 million. As a consequence of these pressures, the company experienced a covenant breach under our senior credit facility. In addition, customer churn spiked to 22% among key enterprise accounts following service outage incidents in August. Days sales outstanding rose to 84 days, compounding our cash burn rate. The company is in active discussions with lenders regarding covenant relief, but there is substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern if secondary financing is not secured.
